title: Writing a Formal Letter
goal: Write the opening, the reason and the closing of a formal letter.

items: I can open a formal letter with *Estimado señor:* or *Estimada señora:*.
I can state the reason for writing with *Le escribo para…*.
I can close a formal letter with *Quedo a la espera de su respuesta* and *Atentamente*.
